mcqs.question: How do you make room for performers who process quietly?

options.text: I alternate open discussion with private preparation. Presence does not have to arrive through speed or volume.
Ideas become less competitive and more detailed. People respond to what was offered instead of racing to offer first.
I would let changing pairs lead a silent scene plan. That may distribute authority without turning inclusion into a speech.
I would reject the approach described here and keep the existing routine unchanged.

mcqs.rationale: The correct option reproduces the answer to this held-out question; the alternatives come from related answers or reverse its intent.
